name: local

deployer.note: The default is anvil's well-known account #0 (0xf39F...2266). It is public and only ever used on local chains.

identity8004.note: Local worlds deploy contracts/src/Identity8004Stub.sol, a stand-in that follows the official ABI surface the ten reference implementations call. It is not the reference registry.

notes: AID liveness windows (90 d / 365 d) and the KYA Groth16 adapter parameters (issuer set root of the upstream kya_public_v1 prover, 30 d epochs, 1 epoch grace) mirror the upstream Sepolia reference deployments so the upstream provers and resolvers work unchanged.
ARD kind URIs mirror the upstream evidence script (kind:<name>).
